title: Graduate Engineer
description:
Join Our Future Engineering Leaders 
 Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) 
 Designation: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) 
 Department: Engineering Development Program 
 Location: Asangaon Plant, Maharashtra 
 Reporting To: Functional Manager / Department Head . 
 About Nirmal Industrial Control Pvt. Ltd. 
 At Nirmal Industrial Control Pvt. Ltd., we design and manufacture innovative flow control solutions that enable critical industries worldwide. Our Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Program is designed to develop the next generation of engineering professionals by providing structured technical training, cross-functional exposure and hands-on experience across engineering, manufacturing, projects, quality, supply chain and customer- facing functions. 
 Position Purpose 
 The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) will undergo a structured learning and development program designed to build strong technical, analytical, and professional capabilities. During the training period, the trainee will work on live engineering assignments, participate in cross-functional rotations, and gain exposure to industrial valves, process automation, manufacturing operations, project execution, and customer engineering. Successful trainees will be deployed into suitable engineering roles based on performance and business 
 requirements. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Participate in structured classroom and on-the-job training programs. Learn Nirmal's products, manufacturing processes, engineering standards and quality systems. Support engineering teams in design, project execution, proposal preparation, manufacturing, quality and application engineering activities. 
 • Prepare engineering documentation, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), technical reports and customer documentation under guidance. Participate in product development, value engineering, and process improvement initiatives to enhance 
 product performance and operational efficiency. 
 •Assist in project execution, technical problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement and Quality. •Participate in Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives. Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards and safety procedures. Complete departmental projects, technical assignments and training modules within defined timelines. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Basic Education (Mandatory) 
 • B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering 
 • B.E./B.Tech in Mechatronics Engineering

Selection Preference 
 •Fresh Engineering Graduates (2025/ 2026 / 2027 Pass-outs). 
 •Candidates with internship or project experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, valves, instrumentation, process industries, or engineering design will be preferred. 
 •Exposure to CAD software, engineering drawings, BOM preparation, manufacturing processes, industrial projects, and strong analytical and problem-solving skills will be an added advantage. 
 Experience 
 Fresh graduates or candidates with up to one year of internship, apprenticeship, or industrial training experience. 
 Technical Competencies 
 
 1. Engineering Fundamentals - Mechanical Engineering, Instrumentation, Manufacturing Processes, Engineering Calculations 
 2. Engineering Documentation - Engineering Drawings, GA Drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), Technical Documentation 
 3. Process Engineering - Industrial Valves, Flow Control, Process Instrumentation, P&ID Basics 
 4. Quality & Manufacturing - Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, Quality Systems, Problem Solving 
 5. Software & Systems - AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Creo (Preferred), ERP, Microsoft Office 

• Behavioural Competencies 
 Analytical Thinking Learning Agility Problem Solving Communication Collaboration Accountability 
 Ownership Adaptability Attention to Detail Continuous Learning.
 Why Join Nirmal? 
 • Structured Graduate Engineer Development Program. 
 •Hands-on exposure to live engineering projects. 
 •Cross-functional learning across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Projects, and Supply Chain. 
 • Learn from experienced engineering professionals and industry experts. 
 • Build expertise in industrial flow control and process automation. 
 • Accelerate your engineering career in a fast-growing manufacturing organization. 
 
 
 


 Shape the future of industrial flow control with Nirmal

Key Skills: PPC,Design Development,Production Engineering,Quality Management,Store Management,Mechanical Engineering,Mechanical,Quality
